name: LinkedIn Profile Analysis - Blockchain Developer
description: Signals extracted from LinkedIn profiles for Blockchain Developer skill assessment. LinkedIn provides professional context, endorsements, posts/articles, and recommendation quality. NOTE: Blockchain developers have unusually strong GitHub evidence — LinkedIn complements rather than leads the assessment. Specific maps_to composite keys are in individual skill files.

headline_summary.notes: Look for blockchain-specific specialization: 'Solidity Developer', 'DeFi Engineer', 'Smart Contract Engineer', 'Web3 Developer', 'Protocol Engineer', 'ZK Engineer'. Generic 'Software Engineer' without blockchain context provides minimal signal.
quality_indicators: Named protocols or chains in headline (Ethereum, Solana, EVM)
GitHub or portfolio link in featured section with blockchain work
Protocol names (Uniswap, Aave, Compound, OpenSea, Chainlink, etc.) as employer or collaborator
Named blockchains and L2s in role descriptions
Duration in blockchain-specific roles (not just companies that happen to have a blockchain feature)
Hackathon wins, ETHGlobal awards, or protocol grants received
Audit firm experience (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, ConsenSys Diligence, Sherlock, Code4rena)

skills_endorsements.notes: Solidity endorsements are increasingly common and low-signal. High-signal: Foundry, Slither, Echidna, ZK proofs, Rust (for Solana/Substrate), cross-chain bridge design.

posts_articles.notes: LinkedIn articles or posts analyzing specific smart contract vulnerabilities, DeFi protocol mechanics, ZK proof systems, or L2 scaling architectures are extremely high-signal for blockchain developers — writing technical content at this depth requires genuine expertise.
quality_indicators: Technical deep-dives on specific vulnerability classes (reentrancy variants, oracle manipulation)
Protocol post-mortems or security analyses of known hacks
ZK proof system comparisons (Groth16 vs PLONK vs STARKs)
Recommendation from protocol founder, lead engineer, or security auditor
Specific mention of security-conscious development practices
Named protocols or hacks the candidate helped prevent/analyze

patterns.pattern: Solidity, EVM, or smart contract development endorsed
DeFi protocol development, Uniswap, Aave, or Compound integration endorsed
Smart contract security, security audit, Slither, or Echidna endorsed
ZK proofs, zkSNARK, zkEVM, or zero-knowledge cryptography endorsed
Chainlink, oracle, or decentralized data feed mentioned
Solana, Rust blockchain, or Anchor framework endorsed
Layer 2, Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync, or rollup development mentioned

important_notes: GitHub is significantly stronger evidence for blockchain developers than LinkedIn — always prioritize GitHub analysis
ETHGlobal hackathon prizes, protocol bug bounty payouts (Immunefi), or Code4rena/Sherlock audit competition rankings are LinkedIn-mentionable achievements that carry high weight
Connections and followers in the Web3/DeFi community (Vitalik Buterin, protocol founders) are weak social proof signals but indicate ecosystem integration
LinkedIn posts analyzing the mechanics of real DeFi hacks (Euler Finance, Cream Finance, Mango Markets) demonstrate genuine security depth that cannot be faked
Audit firm work experience (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, ConsenSys Diligence, Spearbit) is an extremely strong senior signal
